anchor_scope: Root postexecution anchor recorded before independent runtime reconstruction; not a preexecution output prediction or independent timestamp authority.
membership_scope: Exact file membership before and after this audit; empty-directory identities and transient changes are not independently attested.
runtime_semantic_conformance: Separate independent reconstruction; this audit establishes preservation and resource-record consistency only.
scope: Independent stdlib-only content and exact file-membership postcheck; no case execution or policy recomputation

timing_and_resources.outer_scope: Parent launch through command return, including native stage sealing and console redirection when successful; excludes this timing record publication. A launcher error leaves process exit unknown.
timing_and_resources.unknown_reason: No complete process-tree CPU or runtime peak-memory measurement was retained. Timers have different boundaries; group subprocess intervals overlap their contained work.
timing_and_resources.usage_scope: Scripted local provider telemetry; not measured language-model tokenization or actual remote-provider billing.
